scripts.build:retrieval-bench: cargo build -p vfs-canister --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --features canbench-rs --locked && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/vfs_canister.wasm', '../target/retrieval-bench.wasm')"
scripts.test:wiki-retrieval: pnpm run build:retrieval-bench && pnpm run build:wiki && node --test integration/wiki-retrieval-search.test.mjs
scripts.test:public-http: pnpm run build:wiki && pnpm --dir ../wikibrowser build:worker && node --test integration/public-http.test.mjs
scripts.test:wiki-sql: pnpm run build:wiki && pnpm run build:probe && node --test integration/wiki-sql-authorization.test.mjs
scripts.test:learning-revisions: pnpm run build:learning-baseline && pnpm run build:wiki && KINIC_LEARNING_BASELINE_WASM=../target/learning-baseline.wasm node --test integration/learning-revisions.test.mjs
